4.2.1.3 Normal Operation
[SRS_IoHwAb_12242] The IO Hardware Abstraction shall hide any communica-
tion over ECU internal onboard peripherals to access Signals ⌈
Description:
The IO Hardware Abstraction shall hide any communication over ECU internal
onboard peripherals to access Signals. The Signal routing on the ECU is
abstracted by this interface.
Rationale:
It shall be no difference for the upper layers, if a port is connected directly to the
Microcontroller or an onboard ASIC.
